title: BBQS uploader transfer manifest
description: One JSON packet per "Upload" batch, posted to sourcedata/raw/.transfer/transfer-<timestamp>.json (see src/lib/transfer-manifest.ts). Records per-file checksum/upload throughput and a session summary.

schemaVersion.description: Semver of this schema, bumped whenever the manifest shape changes, so a reader can tell historical instances apart. Not tied to the uploader app's own package.json version.

dandisetId.description: The DANDI/EMBER dandiset identifier this batch was uploaded to.

sessionStartedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the first file dropped this session, across every "Upload" click so far.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp this manifest was generated; also the value the manifest's own filename is keyed on.

totalBytes.description: Cumulative bytes across every file queued this session.

hashMBps.description: Checksum throughput (decimal MB/s) at manifest generation time.

uploadMBps.description: Upload throughput (decimal MB/s) at manifest generation time.

MBps.description: Decimal (1 MB = 1,000,000 B) megabytes per second, averaged over the phase's actual duration.

checksum.description: null when not a single chunk was hashed before the job settled (e.g. cancelled immediately); otherwise the rate achieved, whether the checksum finished or was cancelled partway through.

upload.description: null when not a single byte was transferred (blocked, errored, or cancelled immediately); otherwise the rate achieved, whether the upload finished or was cancelled partway through.

status.description: "pending" means the file was queued but this batch never reached it (see UploadOutcome in src/ui/processFile.ts for the rest).
